WITH media_rates AS (
  SELECT m.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM MediaType AS m
  JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM media_rates
),
above AS (
  SELECT r.byte_rate, r.track_count, o.avg_rate
  FROM media_rates AS r
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE r.byte_rate > o.avg_rate
)
SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS average_rate,
       AVG(track_count) AS average_track_count,
       AVG(byte_rate - avg_rate) AS average_excess_rate
FROM above
